json.sql: SELECT a.name, hr.status, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM heartbeat_runs hr JOIN agents a ON hr.agent_id = a.id WHERE hr.started_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY a.name, hr.status ORDER BY a.name, hr.status

SELECT solver_used, COUNT(*) as decisions, SUM(CASE WHEN human_override THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as overrides, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN human_override THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 3) as override_rate FROM decision_journal WHERE ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY solver_used
